name: ask-in-chat
description: In the Claude desktop app's Code tab, has Claude ask its end-of-turn questions in the chat, after its full reply, instead of in the next-step box, where the reply around the question can be cut off or replaced by a one-line summary.

buttons.title: Question buttons
buttons.description: off: Claude asks in the chat and the next-step box shows only its recap (the default). keep: the box keeps Claude's question and buttons, and Claude also writes its full reply and the question in the chat.
